scenario: stuck on a ferry boat drifting without engine power
part1_script: Sound travels four miles across cold open water. One scream draws every infected swimmer to your deck. It is 3:12 in the morning. The main engines died four hours ago. You have forty gallons of water. Below you, 140 infected passengers crowd the car deck. You locked the stairwell using heavy anchor chains. You poured six cans of motor oil across the deck steps. Anything trying to climb up slides away. At 4:05 AM, the backup power surges back on. The loud foghorn blares, lighting up the sea. The steel chain snaps and infected doors burst open. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
last_line: The steel chain snaps and infected doors burst open. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
